summary: pokerbot has no gate script and 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests' runs 0 tests and exits 0 because every test is pytest-style; a gate that used unittest would go green having run nothing. Add a bin/gate.sh to pokerbot that runs the venv's pytest and both number checkers, and record the venv path (.venv is only in some worktrees; system python3 has no pytest).
